text: Given a product_id that exists in Pax8's catalog, When pax8_get_product(product_id) is called with valid credentials, Then the tool returns the Pax8 product record as JSON containing at least id, name, vendorName, shortDescription, sku
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_products.py::test_get_product_returns_pax8_record -v (2026-10-31) -> 1 passed; respx-mocked GET /v1/products/prod-123 returns 200 with id/name/vendorName/shortDescription/sku and the tool's json.dumps output contains all five fields verbatim

text: Given a product_id that does not exist in Pax8 (Pax8 returns 404), When pax8_get_product(product_id) is called, Then the tool returns the string "Error 404: <message>", not a raw exception or stack trace
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_products.py::test_get_product_passes_through_404 -v -> 1 passed; respx-mocked 404 {"message": "Product not found"} surfaces as 'Error 404: ... Product not found ...' string, no exception raised

text: Given Pax8 returns a 5xx error for a given product_id, When pax8_get_product(product_id) is called, Then the tool returns "Error {status}: {message}" and that string never contains the caller's Pax8 access token
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_products.py::test_get_product_error_does_not_leak_token -v -> 1 passed; respx-mocked 500 with token 'super-secret-token' set via gateway contextvar; asserted returned string starts with 'Error 500:' and does not contain 'super-secret-token'

text: Given no Pax8 credentials are available for the current request (gateway mode with no X-Pax8-Token header, or env mode with PAX8_API_TOKEN unset), When pax8_get_product(product_id) is called, Then the tool returns the same "Error: No Pax8 token configured..." message the other 9 tools return, and Pax8 is never called
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_products.py::test_get_product_without_credentials -v -> 1 passed; gateway contextvar left unset, respx route for /v1/products/prod-123 asserted not called, returned text == 'Error: No Pax8 token configured. Set PAX8_API_TOKEN or use AUTH_MODE=gateway.'

text: Given the tool's declared MCP schema, When a client omits the product_id argument on tools/call, Then the call is rejected as a parameter-validation error before any Pax8 API call is attempted (product_id has no default value)
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_products.py::test_get_product_requires_product_id -v -> 1 passed; mcp.call_tool('pax8_get_product', {}) raises mcp.server.fastmcp.exceptions.ToolError ('1 validation error ... product_id ... Field required') and the respx route for /v1/products/* is never called; separately confirmed live over HTTP in scratch/PRD-21601/smoke.py: tools/list inputSchema for pax8_get_product has required=["product_id"]

text: Given two concurrent pax8_get_product calls arrive with two different X-Pax8-Token header values (gateway mode), When both are in flight at the same time, Then each call's outbound request to Pax8 carries only its own token, with no cross-request bleed
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_products.py::test_get_product_concurrent_requests_do_not_share_token -v -> 1 passed; asyncio.gather of two _call_with_token coroutines (tenant-a-token/prod-a, tenant-b-token/prod-b) through the real contextvars.ContextVar isolation path (server._gateway_token_var); respx call log confirms /v1/products/prod-a got 'Bearer tenant-a-token' and /v1/products/prod-b got 'Bearer tenant-b-token', no cross-contamination

text: Given a real Pax8 partner account and a known product_id, When pax8_get_product(product_id) is called through the deployed INT connector, Then the returned id/name/vendorName/shortDescription/sku match the Pax8 partner portal for that product_id
steps: Obtain a real Pax8 partner API token and a known product_id (needs a real vendor account)
Call POST /mcp on the INT deployment with header X-Pax8-Token set, body tools/call pax8_get_product {"product_id": "<id>"}
Compare the returned id/name/vendorName/shortDescription/sku against the Pax8 partner portal for the same product_id
expect: Returned fields match the Pax8 partner portal exactly for that product_id
notes: Needs a real Pax8 vendor account/token, not available during dev. Not a blocker for this ticket per the vendor-mcp track rule (a missing vendor test account never blocks). Unchanged from design leg's recorded state.
